title: thalictrum sylvaticum subsp. frutetorum
intro: Thalictrum sylvaticum subsp. frutetorum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
